title: Harbi2
tagline: As beginners, we've successfully developed a basic token contract on the Arbitrum network, laying the foundation for future projects and learning in the blockchain space.
description: As beginners, we utilized the Remix online IDE to craft a basic token contract on the Arbitrum network. This project served as our introduction to blockchain development, allowing us to grasp the fundamentals of smart contract creation, compilation, and deployment. Through this experience, we learned to navigate the complexities of Ethereum-based development, laying a solid foundation for future blockchain projects.
